numhosts.meaning: The number of end stations that can send or receive traffic

numswitchs.meaning: The number of nodes forwarding the traffic between the end stations

portspeed.meaning: The speed of traffic transmission at the egress ports of the switches and end stations

procdelay.meaning: The time needed by the switches to process a traffic frame

propdelay.meaning: The time needed by the traffic to propagate in the links from an egress port of a switch to an ingress port of the next switch

queuecountperport.meaning: The number of queues available in the egress ports

graphConfig.meaning: A dictionary defining the type and parameters of the network graph

maxstrpernode.meaning: The maximum number of streams that can be sourced from a single node

numberframes_range.meaning: The number of frames per stream within a cycle

maxlatency_range.meaning: The maximum latency constraint of a stream

numplacestalker.meaning: The number of end stations where the talker can possibly be placed

numplaceslistener.meaning: The number of end stations where the listener can possibly be placed

numlistenersperstr.meaning: The maximum number of listeners that can be placed in the same node

routing.meaning: A dictionary defining the routing configuration

generation.meaning: A dictionary defining experiment scenario generation

incrementation.meaning: A boolean defining whether streams used in an experiment are included in the next experiment

expiration.meaning: A dictionary defining the life span of streams

finite_duration.meaning: A boolean indicating whether the stream is finite or continuous during an experiment

start.meaning: The minimum number of cycles a finite stream can live

stop.meaning: The maximum number of cycles a finite stream can live

k.meaning: The parameter of the fat-tree graph

prob.meaning: The probability of connection between nodes in the Erdos-Renyi graph

numcoreswitches.meaning: The number of core switches in the Erdos-Renyi and Barabasi-Albert graphs

Minnodedegreepersw.meaning: The minimum number of connections per switch in the Erdos-Renyi graph

minnodedegreepersw.meaning: The minimum number of connections per switch in the Barabasi-Albert graph

numEdgN.meaning: The number of edge switches in the Barabasi-Albert graph
